coordinates: body frame of mjcf body 'object' (what PoseReader returns)
schema: grounding symbol table: independent interaction POINTS and semantic AXES; frames are composed downstream as frame(origin=<point>, axis=<axis>), matching the emission DSL. Axis -> frame +z, completed by Gram-Schmidt.

spout_tip.comment: calibrate: double-click spout tip in viewer, read body coords

pour_axis.comment: spout direction = yaw +2.7 rad from body +x (SPOUT_YAW_OFFSET calibration, view_pour_tea.py); retires that constant

handle_axis.comment: handle long axis; vertical loop assumed. Grasp TSR slides along this

tilt_axis.comment: up_axis x pour_axis, signed so POSITIVE rotation tips the spout DOWN; derivable, kept explicit for auditability
